# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and expands support for current desktop, mobile, and WebAssembly toolchains. It restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments and refreshes native platform support for .NET 11 previews and Tizen 10.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156, including the current core fork maintenance updates. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system fonts restored for NoDependencies packages** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Current platform toolchains and native assets aligned** — Refreshes .NET 11 preview and WebAssembly native assets, adds Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 build coverage, and brings native GTK4 GPU rendering and pixel scaling to the gallery. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235), [#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
